referenceSources.description:
A white Citroën Visa 1000 Pistes stands in a minimalist indoor setting, its body adorned with red and blue rally stripes and the inscription “4 ROUES MOTRICES” along the lower doors. The hatchback’s quad headlights, yellow fog lamps, and white alloy wheels emphasize its rally-inspired design. A large Citroën emblem hangs on the concrete wall behind the vehicle, reinforcing the brand’s heritage.

This Visa 1000 Pistes was one of nearly 40 classic Citroën models consigned by a Swiss collector and auctioned in Paris. The sale included iconic models such as the DS, 2CV, SM, Traction, an autochenille, and an M35, collectively fetching close to €3 million.
